name: shine
description: Skeleton loader gradient sweep. A translucent highlight band travels left to right across the host. Pair with <Skeleton> + bg-muted for the standard loading affordance. (Named `shine` to avoid colliding with the AI `shimmer` streaming-text effect.)

props.name: width
props.description: Highlight band width as a % of host.

props.name: color
props.description: CSS color for the highlight band.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Optional content rendered behind the sweep.

ai.whenToUse: Use for loading-state cards, table rows, image placeholders. Composes naturally with <Skeleton>.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use without a backing color — the gradient blends into white space and shows nothing.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to set a background (bg-muted, bg-card) on the host — the highlight is invisible.
Using vivid `color` values — the band should be subtle white/translucent for both themes.
ai.accessibilityNotes: Animation suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion. Pair with role='status' + aria-busy='true' on the parent so screen readers announce loading.
